en: A black‑and‑white photograph of two women standing outdoors on fallen leaves, wearing elaborate traditional folk costumes. Each has a long dark skirt with floral embroidery near the hem, a wide belt or sash, and a high, pouch‑like bodice. The woman on the left wears a light blouse with embroidered vest and a rounded cap; the woman on the right wears a darker jacket and a distinctive tall, folded white headdress. Trees with dense foliage fill the background. There is no visible printed caption on the front.
